title: BalletOS Vaganova Metrics Schema
description: Machine-readable rule model for Vaganova-based ballet skeleton analysis. Each metric entry specifies the epistemological class, measurement validity, and source provenance. NO research_observation or pedagogical_nominal_angle values may be used as health or error thresholds without system validation.

references.vaganova_primary: Vaganova, А.Я. Основы классического танца, 6th ed., 2000. ISBN 978-5-8114-0397-8
references.mediapipe_limits: BlazePose GHUM Model Card, Google 2022 — monocular depth 'out of scope'
references.valgus_limit: Asaeda M. et al. 2024, PMC11399566 — single-leg drop landing only; normalization at initial contact, not a ballet/Plié validation
references.turnout_limits: IADMS Turnout Resource Paper, Revision 2025 — 180° anatomically unrealistic for many individuals
references.multi_segment_turnout: Gorwa J. et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0230654 — foot angle ≠ hip rotation
references.isb_coordinates: Wu G. et al. 2002, J Biomech PMID 11934426 — ISB Joint Coordinate System

measurement_classes.vaganova_relation: Relational technique rule from Vaganova pedagogy — often directional or boolean, not a precise degree target
measurement_classes.pedagogical_nominal_angle: Vaganova spatial height convention (e.g. 90° = leg at hip height) — NOT an anatomical joint angle
measurement_classes.research_observation: Group mean from biomechanical study — context only, NEVER use as individual threshold
measurement_classes.validated_system_threshold: Threshold established after comparison against calibrated Mocap/Vicon reference
measurement_classes.not_measurable: Cannot be reliably measured with current sensor; output must say so explicitly

studio_biomechanics.description: Two synchronized calibrated cameras + Ballet landmark set

metrics.note: No canonical Vaganova knee-flexion value for plié. NIH group mean ~135° ±4.6° is observational, not a prescription. Do NOT use as error threshold.

source_limit.context: single-leg drop landing normalized at initial contact; not transferable as a Plié threshold

metrics.mediapipe_validity: no validated Plié view, mirror, phase, or reference-anchor contract
metrics.not_measurable_output: Nicht messbar: Referenzframe, Perspektive, Spiegelung und Bewegungsphase sind nicht bestätigt.

metrics.exception: Épaulement positions intentionally use shoulder asymmetry — must not flag as error
Arbeitsbein, Gewichtsverlagerung, Arabesque und Kameraperspektive können eine sichtbare Neigung beabsichtigt oder projektionsbedingt verändern; Nicole prüft die Phase.
metrics.note: Verbindung der sichtbaren Hüftpunkte; kein anatomischer 3D-Beckenwinkel und keine Muskel- oder Kraftmessung.
Foot opening angle ≠ hip external rotation. IADMS 2025: individual bone structure makes 180° frequently unrealistic. Gorwa 2020: same foot angle can come from 4 different segment combinations.
No universal shoulder angle for 2nd position (Vaganova). This 3-point elbow angle is a valid proxy only in calibrated frontal view.
2D image projection, not ISB spinal segmental angle. Indicates gross postural deviation only.
